observations: Photo 0: a black three-layer games console with 'SONY' printed on the front edge and a 'PS4' logo on the top right corner, the chassis shape of a PS4 Pro.
Two red controllers in retail boxes labelled 'DUALSHOCK 4 Wireless Controller' with PS4 logos and Japanese text, stacked on the console.
Strips of beige tape on the left edge of the console layers, possibly seal stickers or tape holding something.
Cables run from the back of the console to a wall socket; the console is not shown powered on and no screen is in shot.
No games, discs or game boxes are visible.
Surface looks clean in this staged, well-lit photo; dealer watermark 'GAME ARENAOFFICAL'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean-looking console surface, though only one angle and no close-ups.
Origin cannot be shown in a photo; a UK model label on the underside would only hint at it.
Photo 0 shows 'SONY', a 'PS4' logo and the three-layer PS4 Pro chassis; the model plate on the underside is not shown.
No games are visible in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows two boxed DualShock 4 controllers; genuineness is not proven.
Only one angle; no close-ups of ports, vents or underside.
Internal history cannot be shown; tape strips on the console edge in photo 0 are unexplained.
No clip of the console booting, reading a disc or a controller pairing.
No receipt or warranty shown; unusual for a UK-used console.

risks.risk: Console may not boot, may overheat, or the disc drive may fail to read.
risks.proof: A clip of the console powering on to the home screen, then loading a game from disc.

risks.risk: Console may be account-banned or locked, or the hard drive may be missing or smaller than original.
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > System > System Information showing model number, storage and system software.
risks.if_unproven: as missing hard drive and unable to go online

risks.risk: The boxed controllers may be non-genuine copies, which are common.
risks.proof: Clip of each controller pairing with the console and moving through the menu, plus a photo of the label on the back of each pad.

risks.risk: The 10 games may not be included or may be digital titles tied to the seller's account.
risks.proof: A photo of the 10 game discs laid out with a handwritten note of today's date.

risks.risk: Tape on the console edge may hide damage or a broken seal from a repair.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the taped edges with the tape removed, and the underside model plate.

risks.risk: Photo may be a dealer stock image, not the unit being sold.
risks.proof: Photo of the console with a handwritten note of today's date and the underside serial plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case, payment only after agent inspection

proof_requests: Clip of the console booting to the home screen and loading a disc game.
Screenshot of System Information showing model number and storage.
Photo of the underside model and serial plate with a handwritten note of today's date.
Clip of each controller pairing and working.
Close-ups of the taped edges with tape removed.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a Sony PS4 Pro by its markings and chassis plus two boxed DualShock 4 pads, so it can be priced at worst case as not working, without games and with non-genuine pads, until a boot clip and system information are shown.
